name.en: Ballasted tilted frame on flat roof with concrete ballast trays (Esdec FlatFix Fusion type)
name.es: Estructura inclinada lastrada sobre cubierta plana con bandejas de lastre de hormigón (tipo Esdec FlatFix Fusion)

description.en: Aluminium base profiles carry low and high plastic base elements that rest on the roof membrane or protection mat. Ballast holders (trays) carry concrete paving slabs as dead weight; stabilisers and roof supports give lateral and tilt stability. Modules are fixed with universal mid clamps and end clamps on the base profiles. Reference family: Esdec FlatFix Fusion (tilt 13 degrees, East-West or portrait landscape variants per manual).
description.es: Perfiles base de aluminio sostienen elementos base altos y bajos de plástico que apoyan sobre la membrana o la manta de protección. Las bandejas de lastre sostienen losetas de hormigón como peso muerto; los estabilizadores y apoyos de cubierta dan estabilidad lateral e inclinación. Los módulos se fijan con garras intermedias universales y garras de extremo sobre los perfiles base. Familia de referencia: Esdec FlatFix Fusion (inclinación 13 grados).

typical_use: Flat roofs with a load-bearing membrane or concrete deck where no roof penetration is allowed; ballast gives wind uplift resistance.
applicable_standards: EN 1991-1-4 (wind actions, designer; ballast mass and wind suction to be designed per project)
EN 1999-1-1 (aluminium design, designer; not verified in this research)

profiles.name: Esdec FlatFix Fusion base profile (lengths 210, 370, 550, 750 and 940 mm)

geometry.description: East-West or portrait/landscape rows with base profile under each module frame, base elements on the membrane, ballast trays along the rows. Schematic only: row spacing range from the manual is given in reference_layout, not as element coordinates.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

elements.note: Reference base profile length from manual. Placeholder origin, not a design layout.

reference_layout.note: Tilt 13 degrees (manual). Maximum roof pitch 3 degrees; sealing required between 3 and 7 degrees. Panel length 1170 to 2080 mm, width 980 to 1053 mm, thickness 25 to 50 mm. Maximum centre-to-centre spacing of FlatFix segments 2 m. Row distance (dual landscape) 2110 to 2840 mm depending on base profile length. Minimum edge distance 30 cm or about one fifth of building height.
